description: Asks what StrConv with each mode (1 upper, 2 lower, 3 proper, 4 wide, 8 narrow, 16 katakana, 32 hiragana, 64 Unicode, 128 from Unicode), Format with the text pictures >, <, @@@@@@, !@@@@@@, &&& and a quoted literal, Format$, CStr, CVar, Trim$, UCase$ and Chr(Asc()) return for the stored edge strings of Tx (rows with a non-Null, non-empty T). Each form is one snapshot ordered by ID, followed by DBEngine.Errors. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
